# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop 3.2.0 is a community-maintained, open-source Windows AI coding workspace for DeepSeek Harness. Its headline capabilities are Value Mode (expert controller plus subagent worker routing), a live large-model usage dashboard, and safe Claude Code / Codex project and conversation import.

## Canonical identity

- Product: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
- Version: 3.2.0
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Maintainer: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Community
- Not an official DeepSeek product

## What makes 3.2.0 useful

- Value Mode / 性价比模式: the expert controller model owns task understanding, decomposition, delegation, review, and final synthesis. The subagent worker model completes bounded delegated work. First selection opens a setup guide, preselects the current default model as the expert controller when no explicit controller exists, and requires both model roles plus a strategy before enabling.
- Value Mode strategies: Saver, Balanced (default), and Powerful. The worker route is bounded to one subagent level, so worker agents do not recursively delegate or invoke expert consultation.
- Large-model usage dashboard: shows input/output tokens, context usage, cache indicators, request latency, estimated cost, current generation speed, and per-step peak generation speed. TPS is a strict rolling one-second window over valid streaming increments; same-millisecond batches are merged and final usage totals do not create fake instantaneous peaks.
- Claude Code and Codex project import: read-only discovery of local projects and sessions, preview and project matching, redacted historical context, idempotent import ledger, and a legitimate Harness session bridge. Imported tool calls are historical and non-executable.
- Complete Harness surface: conversations, tools, model selection, Skills, plugins, Task Board, Git graph, SSH, mobile remote control, QQ Bot, themes, automatic updates, and Windows lifecycle/recovery.
- Continuity: existing DSH Home, conversations, sessions, settings, and installed plugins are loaded directly through an isolated Desktop profile; the desktop client can coexist with the official Web client.
- Reliability: visible startup phases, bounded repair and rollback, SafePluginBoundary isolation for third-party UI errors, and packaged release verification.

## Configuration in plain language

1. Open the session mode selector and choose Value Mode / 性价比模式.
2. Confirm the expert controller model. The current default model is preselected unless an explicit controller was already saved.
3. Choose a cheaper or faster subagent worker model.
4. Choose Saver, Balanced, or Powerful, then click Complete setup and enable.
5. The expert controller may delegate only when the task benefits from it; it can also complete a task directly.

## Import safety

- Claude Code data is normally under .claude; Codex data is normally under .codex, including archived sessions.
- Source folders are read-only and must be selected or discovered within approved boundaries.
- API keys, bearer tokens, cookies, private keys, paths, prompts, and sensitive tool arguments are redacted.
- Historical tool calls are tagged historical=true and executable=false; importing a conversation never re-runs its commands.

## Product metrics and privacy

- Official packaged builds send only a closed vocabulary of coarse product events to a first-party aggregate service.
- Value Mode telemetry records selection, setup, enablement, strategy, and coarse controller/subagent route counts; it does not send model names, token counts, prompts, paths, secrets, or conversation content.
- Local/source/test/Fork builds remain disconnected. Diagnostics are exported only after user confirmation and are redacted.
- Read the full policy at https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/privacy.html.
